chunks: From him, from Suleyman ibn Sama'ah, from Abdullah ibn al-Qasim, from Sama'ah who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'When Adam (peace be upon him) died, Iblis and Qabil rejoiced over him, and they gathered in the earth. So Iblis and Qabil made the musical instruments and amusements as a gloating over Adam (peace be upon him). Thus, everything in the earth from this type, which people derive pleasure from, is indeed from that.'
ai.seo_question: What is the origin of music and worldly pleasures according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) narrates that when Adam (peace be upon him) died, Iblis and Qabil rejoiced and gathered on earth, using musical instruments and amusements to gloat over his death. This narration establishes the origin of music and worldly pleasures as stemming from their celebration, linking the primordial joy of the devil to the sensory distractions that later characterized human indulgence. In Shia scholarship, this is often interpreted as the spiritual root of *lahw* (diversion) that distances the soul from divine remembrance.
